exceptions.reason: PR118 is the change that introduces issue_comment reconciliation into deterministic-assurance, while GitHub evaluates issue_comment workflow availability from the default branch; the trigger therefore cannot protect the same PR before that workflow has landed on main.
compensating_controls: Immediately before merge eligibility, fetch and reconcile top-level PR comments, inline review comments, and formal reviews against the exact current PR head.
Do not merge PR118 while any material P0/P1 finding is unresolved or while the exact-head CI matrix is not fully successful.
exceptions.expires_when: deterministic-assurance issue_comment trigger is present on default branch after PR118 merge
